title.value: Toward Debugging Deep Reinforcement Learning Programs with RLExplorer
title.justification: The title precisely captures the main focus of the paper, which is about the RLExplorer tool intended to aid in debugging DRL programs.
title.quote: In this paper, we propose RLExplorer, the first fault diagnosis approach for DRL-based software systems.

analysis.description: This paper presents RLExplorer, a tool designed to automate the debugging and fault diagnosis process for Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) programs. The tool monitors the training process, detects faults, and provides actionable insights to improve debugging efficiency. Evaluations show that RLExplorer identifies significantly more defects than manual debugging and is well-received by practitioners.

type.justification: The paper includes evaluations of RLExplorer on actual DRL samples from Stack Overflow and a human study involving DRL practitioners, indicating an empirical study.
type.quote: To evaluate RLExplorer, we assessed RLExplorer using 11 real faulty DRL samples collected from Stack Overflow (SO). Results show that RLExplorer was able to detect and diagnose faults in 83% of cases. We further conduct a human study with 15 DRL practitioners to assess RLExplorer’s effectiveness and usability in helping developers diagnose faults.
